meta.name: grill-me
meta.description: A relentless interview to sharpen a plan or design.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用访谈式提问帮您打磨计划与设计
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你常常需要把不成熟的想法梳理得清晰可行
copy.tagline_en: Hone your plan or design through relentless questioning.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to sharpen rough ideas into clear plans.

howto.what: Claude 会围绕你的计划或设计进行一轮接一轮的追问,反复深挖细节,形成一场“拷问式”对话,帮你把方案想得更扎实。
howto.when: 该技能不会自动调用,需要你主动发起。当你在对话中输入 /grilling 并给出要讨论的计划或设计时进入。

say.note: Claude 会开始针对推广计划连续提问。

say.text: 启动 /grilling,主题是这套 UI 设计方案
say.note: 它会逐条追问设计取舍。

say.text: 用 /grilling 打磨一下我的演讲稿
say.note: 围绕演讲稿的漏洞展开追问。

howto.what_en: Claude runs a relentless Q&A session about your plan or design, digging into details with successive questions to sharpen it.
howto.when_en: The skill is not invoked automatically. It kicks in when you actively run a /grilling session with a plan or design to discuss.

say_en.note: Claude will start questioning the plan.

say_en.text: Start /grilling on this UI design proposal
say_en.note: It will probe each design choice.

say_en.text: Use /grilling to polish my speech draft
say_en.note: It will grill the draft for weak points.
